optimizer: Adam restore identical complete frozen optimizer state for all groups

scales.scale_reduction: window RMS over common train cohort

cohort.training_distribution: CRM common-support .5s windows; NOT original .2/.5/1/2s mixed distribution

sampling: seed17 IID date -> flight -> window, with replacement; shared order all groups; no adaptive probabilities

calibration.independent_rng: SeedSequence(17,spawn_key=(1,)); independent draws, not necessarily disjoint identities
calibration.rule_origin: premeasurement operational stability gates; ratio must stay within factor four of 25%; any pairwise opposite Dynamics squared-moment direction stops; not performance acceptance thresholds

moment: two pass, no-grad exact MB then backprop 2*MB*mean(m_i); all belief fields detached only on CRM branch
full_macro: original model(batch,1).total: window-mean FULL+Macro, invalid Macro=0; never divide by microbatch valid-pair counts
evaluation: only after all groups complete update64; initial plus B0/B1/B2; frozen PACLD156, A2 fixed feature identities, CIR306; no sealed test
publication: aggregate allowlist only; no new raw/window/checkpoint data published
